analysis_source: Nepal Flood WASH Severity Analysis - Master Data
notes: Official model weights: P1 50%, P2 35%, P3 15%.
Within P1, affected-population impact contributes 40% and WSS impact 60% where PDNA raw data are available.
P2 uses PDNA raw data on current service status and drinking-water safety/public-health, adjusted by how much of the affected population is represented by assessed WSS beneficiaries.
Municipalities without current PDNA raw data use a provisional P2 of 2.5 and are flagged as lower-confidence evidence.
Final severity classes: Very High >3.5; High 3.0–3.5; Moderate 2.5–<3.0; Low 2.0–<2.5; Minimal <2.0.
Exact PDNA infrastructure coordinates remain non-public.
Detailed source disclosure is maintained in data/source_registry.json.
